latest_release.name: netty-4.2.20.Final
latest_release.body:
## Security Fixes
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-m77g-r4c7-3w77 - out-of-bounds read in `netty-buffer`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-v2v6-vch9-4pcg - inefficient CPU computation in `netty-codec-http3`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-rx4g-qxm6-238r - out-of-bounds read in `netty-buffer`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-cqmg-wc9g-fpj8 - insufficient entropy in `netty-resolver-dns`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-hc9x-r52h-gh4x - unbounded memory usage in `netty-codec-http2`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-42mp-m8rq-6rgj - insufficient control character neutralization in `netty-codec-http`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-w53r-xhgx-8582 - use-after-free in `netty-codec-classes-quic`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-qhw9-p586-v948 - out-of-bounds read in `netty-buffer`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-84gx-4cj4-rm7q - unbounded memory usage in `netty-codec-mqtt`
* https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-6xv6-9mgg-mfvc - mTLS auth bypass via session resumption in `netty-handler` and `netty-codec-quic`

## What's Changed
* IoUring: Fix empty writev submissions after sendmsg_zc by @dreamlike-ocean in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17782
* Do not let a negatively cached search domain shadow a positive one by @akilegaspi in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17623
* Fix musl verify job by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17801
* Reject Redis lines that start with LF by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17793
* Choose server key types from client's signature algorithms for TLS 1.3 by @eager-signal in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17764
* Port 4.2: LocalChannel: Deliver data written by the peer before it closed (#17814) by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17816
* Validate padding of HEADERS frames without priority by @bryce-anderson in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17817
* Don't spin in SslHandler.wrapMultiple(...) when the engine consumes nothing by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17728
* Preserve invalid SNI names in `ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine` by @gavinbunney in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17781
* Optimize redundant bounds checking in ByteBuf.setBytes by @vpelikh in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17023
* Respect SETTINGS_QPACK_BLOCKED_STREAMS for unacknowledged QPACK entries by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17754
* Release the DNS response when a query future loses a cancel race by @watson-ryan in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17475
* Lazily instantiate VarHandle JCTools queues via holder class by @arnabnandy7 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17750
* Keep reading a closed QUIC stream until the end of its input by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17755
* Throw UnsupportedOperationException from AdaptiveByteBuf.memoryAddress() without an address by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17820
* HAProxyMessage: validate the length of all TLV types by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17834
* Fix HpackDynamicTable losing entries when filled to capacity by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17831
* Make AdaptiveByteBuf.memoryAddress() faster by @lhotari in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17767
* Validate bzip2 Huffman code lengths before building decode tables by @Raghuvardhan-Reddy78 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17812
* Validate header values on DefaultHeaders.copy(), bulk add, entry setValue and ReadOnlyHttpHeaders by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17841
* Throw DecompressionException on JdkZlib preset dictionary mismatch by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17838
* Reject HTTP version numbers that
